rows.Origin:
Bred by Bernard Sauvageot (France, 1990).
Introduced in France by Roseraies Sauvageot in 2000 as 'Amours de Saverne'.
rows.Bloom: Cherry-red, silver(y) reverse. (Rouge velouté revers argenté). Moderate fragrance. Full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
rows.Notes:
Source: L'Haÿ-les-roses Label
Participated in the 1996 Monza Competition (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
Christened June 1998 on occasion of the centenary of the Saverne rosarium.
